items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The API types have clear names (ConsistentHashHeader, ConsistentHashCookieAttribute) and thorough doc comments on every field, including the dedup and order rules. The core logic sits in its own file, consistent_hash.go, and follows the plugin's naming conventions.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Follows the plugin pattern: types, generated deepcopy/CRD from `make go-generate-apis`, a dedicated consistent_hash.go and a golden test. No hand edits to generated code are visible, and there is no debug output.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: CEL regex check on ttl plus Go parsing; a bad value becomes a policy error. Regex pattern validated. MaxLength/MaxItems limits throughout (ttl MaxLength=32 added to pass the CEL cost check). Optional fields use pointer types.

items.name: Multi-policy merge semantics
items.evidence: Golden merge output: X-User then x-tenant headers, cookies session/other, queryParameter, filterState, then sourceIp terminal=true, all in canonical order. Metadata `consistentHash: [route-consistent-hash-a, route-consistent-hash-b]`. Hidden tests pass.

items.name: Empty spec and disable handling
items.name_zh: 空配置与 disable 处理
items.evidence: Golden test: disable route has no hashPolicy and inherit route gets `connectionProperties: sourceIp: true`. CRD includes the CEL rule 'no other fields may be set when disable is true'.
